202A.3 / CHAPTER 3 OF 11

Buy/sell pressure

Are the buys actually outweighing the sells?

11 chapters with worked investigations

01Price moves at the margin02Liquidity & price impact03Buy/sell pressure04Supply transfer05Early wallet flow06Demand acceleration07Attention conversion08Push, Hold or Fail09Meta saturation10Migration as event risk11PVP Dominance & Rotation

01Definition

Pressure combines trade value, frequency, and how long the activity persists.

02Why it matters

Many small buys can be outweighed by one large sell.

03What to check

  • Buy and sell value in the same window
  • Typical sizes and the largest trades
  • Whether the pattern persists in the next window

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Buying persists and repeated selling meets new demand.

Dangerous

Green transaction counts hide large sell value.

05Beginner mistake

Counting colors instead of measuring value.

06Takeaway

Read size, frequency, and persistence together.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    20 buys × $100 = $2,000 bought.

  2. 02

    1 sell × $5,000 = $5,000 sold.

  3. 03

    This sample has 19 more buys, but $3,000 more sell value.

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

Window A shows $12,000 buys and $10,000 sells: observed net is +$2,000. One $9,000 buy supplies most of that buying. Window B shows $8,000 buys across many smaller trades and $6,000 sells. Both have +$2,000 net, but the participation patterns differ.

How to investigate it

Use equal windows, the same pool coverage, and consistent buy/sell classification. Inspect the largest swaps and size distribution, then review the next independent window. A sender can be a router and trade count is not a count of people. Net observed flow also is not total cash deposited.

Check your reasoning — answered

Is a positive net sufficient to call demand broad? No. A single buyer, routing steps, or repetitive activity can dominate. Describe concentration before interpreting persistence.

Try it on a token

See it in Meme Fast → Inspect

Compare buy/sell value and swap sizes for one listing and time window. Net value describes the returned sample.

Go deeper

Size × frequency × persistence is a thinking aid, not a defined trading score. Observed buy value minus sell value is not a measurement of total capital entering the token, and it does not by itself determine the price outcome.
